content.text:
Checking the row-4 values at columns 2 and 3, but since the bottom row shows zeros there, that block isn't grounded, so I'm skipping it. Moving from position 0 through columns 1-4, then at column 5 I find a grounded height of 2, so the piece jumps to the empty column 6.

Continuing forward, column 7 similarly has height 2, landing at empty column 8, then column 9 is empty so I move through 9, 10, to column 11, which is the last column and contains a star shape. I'm mapping out the star's center at position (1,10), with its five cells extending up, down, left, and right from that center point.
